Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get everything out of your head and into a simple, elegant system — clearing all the open loops and reducing mental stress. A simple, easy-to-use to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make organising, following up on, and completing tasks deeply satisfying. Get Stuff done.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered straight to your ears the moment they're released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • A new iPad mini with an OLED display is expected to launch before the end of October.
  • John Ternus makes his first public appearance as Apple CEO, laying out his priorities.
  • Apple's executive leadership page gets an update to reflect John Ternus as the new CEO.
  • Apple reveals so-called 'smoking gun' evidence from a former employee's MacBook in lawsuit against OpenAI.
